description: This Zenodo deposit contains 8,874 records assembled for solar-flare prediction from vector magnetic-field information and flare observations. Researchers at UNASP and UNICAMP combined Joint Science Operations Center and Space Weather Prediction Center sources using SunPy. The repository states coverage from May 2010 to December 2019 and lists a CSV file plus a training-and-test archive. Access is free under the MIT licence recorded by Zenodo. The source metadata does not establish the train/test split, event-selection rule or uniform sampling interval, and neither file was downloaded. These records describe solar events, not observed failures of a terrestrial asset. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating a solar-flare forecast that supplies hazard scenarios to communication or space-infrastructure studies; an additional model would be needed to translate forecasts into service effects. data-jw-fd-solar-flare-forecasting-dataset is a distinct related forecasting dataset with different coverage and inputs. The extraction software has its own deposit and is reviewed separately.
name: HMI solar-flare prediction dataset, 2010–2019
notes: G2 G2-0029. Metadata-only review. Simulation uses and cross-resource relations are reviewer assessments. No data or archive downloaded and no simulation run.
